scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible finite consistency checks are supplied. Historical comparisons were based on accessible papers and records, not exhaustive priority proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to zero forcing, positive rational coefficient a>0, nonzero coupling c and forward real trajectories. Initial-state-dependent constants X,C are not given by closed formulas. No uniform asymptotic across all initial points or negative-a analysis is asserted; independent priority review remains outstanding.
title: Global ballistic escape with logarithmic shear in a planar rational map
